'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 871
|text = The cryptic reveals where to dig:<br><br>I am a token of the greatest love. I have no beginning or end. My eye is red, I can fit like a glove. Go to the place where it's money they lend, And dig by the gate to be my friend.
|items = [[Spade]]
|notes = Dig near the gate in the basement of the [[Varrock west bank|West Varrock bank]].
|map = {{Map|3191,9825|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Cooking Guild]].
*[[Ring of wealth]] teleport to the [[Grand Exchange]].
*[[Varrock Teleport]] and run west, or Varrock Teleport to the [[Grand Exchange]] and run south-east with the [[Medium Varrock Diary]] completed.
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Toby]].
*[[Spirit tree]] to the [[Grand Exchange]].
*[[Combat bracelet]] or [[chronicle]] teleport to the [[Champions' Guild]] and run north-west around the edge of [[Varrock]] to the [[Varrock west bank|west bank]].
*[[Skull sceptre]] or [[skull sceptre (i)]] teleport to [[Barbarian Village]] and run east across the [[River Lum]].
